newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara Malaysia goes on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara Malaysia goes on Internet.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank, Bank Negara Malaysia, said on Monday it had launched a web site on the Internet to provide regular updates on the country's economic developments and financial situation.

Through the web site, "information published by the central bank will, from now, be made available through the Internet, in addition to the current practice of disseminating through the press and publication media", a Bank Negara statement said.

The service will include press releases and announcements made by the central bank, extracts of publications, and data as prescribed by the International Monetary Fund's special data dissemination standard, the bank said.
Users can access the web site at http://www.bnm.gov.my.
